name: Choice functions
description: Definition A1.189: CHF(A) is the set of choice functions for the subsets of the nonempty set A, i.e. functions from the power set of A to A sending every nonempty subset B to an element of B.

elements.text: CHF(A) = {CHA ∈ FNS(𝒫A, A) : if B ⊆ A and B ≠ ∅ then CHA(B) ∈ B}.
A choice function is a function from the power set of A to A.
If B ⊆ A and B ≠ ∅ then CHA(B) ∈ B.
CHF(A) is not empty for every nonempty A.
